text:
kevin: deploy-bot just paused the cut for 2026.03.23-rc3. preflight failing at `changelog-gen` step with missing author metadata, anyone pick this up?
deploy-bot: [automated] Promotion paused for build 2026.03.23-rc3: preflight step `changelog-gen` returned exit code 1. Inspect with `/deploybot inspect 1767781111`.
tess: I pulled the logs, shows KeyError for commit['author']['email'] from the changelog tool. snippet:
``nERROR changelog: missing author.email for commit a4c1d2e
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tools/changelog.py", line 112, in main
    email = commit['author']['email']
KeyError: 'email'
```
liam: probably from an imported patch where git author fields didn't carry over. Two quick routes: (1) run a synth that maps name->email heuristics and re-run changelog, (2) attach a manual changelog file and re-run preflight, or (3) hotfix changelog to accept author.name if email missing.
rachel: product note 97 for enterprise customers we need a stable contact in release metadata for auditing. If we attach manual changelog, SOC needs to sign off for the accounts in the compliance list.
security-bot: Reminder: change window closes in 27m. Manual promotions outside window require SOC approval.
kevin: what's the blast radius if we force-promote and tag? any contractual reporting impact?
rachel: audit logs must contain contact info; retro-fixing notes after the cut is allowed but must be recorded and timestamped. SOC prefers we avoid retro edits unless urgent.
tess: I can run the synth tool now. It looks up author names from the merge commits and synthesizes emails using our standard domain fallback (e.g., name@redwood.ai) and adds a note to the changelog metadata about synthesized entries. quick and reversible. estimate 6m.
liam: if you go that path, add a marker in the notes like "(email synthesized)" so audit teams can filter.
kevin: sounds good. do it and post the temporary file for product review in #release-review. I'll stand by to run promote once preflight passes.
tess: running synth and re-run preflight.
tess: posted /tmp/changelog_synth.md to #release-review with synthesized emails flagged. preflight results:
``nchangelog-gen: synthesized 7 entries (3 emails synthesized)
preflight: PASS (1 warning: synthesized emails present)
```
liam: ready to promote when kevin gives the go. use normal promote flow, do NOT use skip flags.
kevin: go ahead, liam. ensure tag remains v2026.03.23-rc3.
liam: executing:
``n/deploybot promote --build 2026.03.23-rc3 --changelog /tmp/changelog_synth.md
```
deploy-bot: Promotion started for build 2026.03.23-rc3. Preflight: PASS. Canary rollout initiated, ETA ~6m.
security-bot: Monitoring policy applied: canary telemetry and audit write checks for 15m post-rollout.
rachel: I'll scan the changelog draft post-rollout and file the SOC approval note if everything's in order.
kevin: monitoring canaries now. rollback runbook ready: `/deploybot rollback --to-tag v2026.03.22 --confirm`.
liam: canaries healthy at 5m, no errors.
tess: promo complete, changelog uploaded with synthesized-email markers.
kevin: closing thread 97 release promoted. document the synthesis process in the release ticket. thanks all."
